snippet.title: Red Blue Cell has been released on STEAM. Normal All Clear / 红蓝细胞已发售STEAM，通关流程演示 Normal难度
snippet.description:
STEAM LINK
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3262220

System Introduction:

Red state absorbs red bullets, blue state absorbs blue bullets
States can be changed at any time
Absorb bullets to increase energy, release energy attacks

If the enemy bullets are different in color from ours, they will cause damage to ours

Killing enemies of the same color with normal attacks will get double GOOD points
Killing any enemy with energy attacks will get double GOOD points

BOSS kill conditions: all parts are broken, and the main body is killed with energy attacks

Supplement:
References to Ikaruga and Summer Carnival '92 - Recca
Although the DEMO trial is very easy, the core gameplay of this game is actually quite complicated and requires a lot of thinking. I wonder if players will like this system


系统简介：

红颜色状态吸收红色子弹，蓝颜色状态吸收蓝色子弹
状态可以随时转换
吸收子弹增加能量，释放能量攻击

如果敌人子弹与我方颜色不相同，则会对我方造成伤害

普通攻击杀死同色敌人，可以得到 GOOD 双倍分数
能量攻击杀死任何敌人，都可以得到 GOOD 双倍分数

BOSS完杀条件：零部件全部击破，本体用能量攻击杀死

补充：
参考了很多  Ikaruga 和 Summer Carnival '92 - Recca
这个游戏内核玩法比较复杂需要思考很多，希望玩家能喜欢
